description: When each runtime surface must not be restarted. Times are Beijing (UTC+8), bounds inclusive, and the windows apply on every weekday - holidays included, deliberately: a calendar mistake must not open a window. Read by scripts/release_window.py; every script that restarts one of these surfaces asks it first.

windows.name: morning-session
windows.why: pre-open checks at 08:40 and 09:10, the call auction and the morning session

windows.name: afternoon-session
windows.why: the afternoon session and the close; the midday break between the two is open by operator decision of 2026-10-12

windows.name: post-close-scheduler
windows.why: the scheduler's post-close pipeline runs then; a restart abandons it half-way
